description: This file defines React functional components for profile UI elements, including Avatar, MetaRow, ProfileHeader, SectionTitle, ReadonlyFieldRow, LinkRow, and SkillCard, intended for use in a user profile interface.

methods.name: Avatar
methods.description: Renders a circular avatar with either an image or initials based on provided props.

methods.name: MetaRow
methods.description: Displays a small, muted icon with accompanying text.

methods.name: ProfileHeader
methods.description: Displays a profile header with avatar, name, headline, location, and optional right accessory.

methods.name: SectionTitle
methods.description: Displays a section heading with optional right accessory.

methods.name: ReadonlyFieldRow
methods.description: Displays a read-only field with label and value, styled for verified email display.

methods.name: LinkRow
methods.description: Displays a clickable external link in a resume-like row.

methods.name: SkillCard
methods.description: Shows a skill with name, level badge, proficiency dropdown, and remove button.
